source: The plaintiff’s family doctor, Dr Angela Ng, had diagnosed a slipped invertebral disc at L4/5.

source: Ms Young Mei Wan, the school’s supervisor. She gave evidence that the plaintiff had hurt her ankles on a skiing holiday in Korea about four months earlier and that the plaintiff had said at the time that her ankle had “given way”.
